findings.location: Header subtitle text ("We love being scraped!")
findings.issue: The light blue/gray text has an insufficient contrast ratio against the white background, failing the WCAG AA standard of 4.5:1 for normal text.
findings.user_impact: Users with low vision, aging eyes, or those viewing the screen in bright environments will struggle to read this secondary branding message.
findings.recommendation: Darken the subtitle text color to a deeper gray (such as #595959) or the primary brand blue to establish a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.

findings.issue: The 'Add to basket' buttons do not align horizontally across rows. Variable book title lengths (e.g., 'Vagabonding: An Uncommon Guide...' wrapping to two lines) cause vertical shifts in the elements below them.
findings.user_impact: Creates a jagged visual path, making the grid look unpolished and increasing the cognitive effort required to scan and click action buttons across a row.
findings.recommendation: Apply a flexbox layout to the product cards (`display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between;`) and set a fixed min-height or line clamping on the book title container so that the buttons always align perfectly along the bottom of the row.

findings.location: Warning alert banner text ("Warning! This is a demo website...")
findings.issue: The brownish-yellow text on the light yellow background does not achieve the required 4.5:1 WCAG AA contrast ratio for standard body text.
findings.user_impact: Visually impaired or color-blind users may miss or struggle to read this important informational disclaimer.
findings.recommendation: Darken the text color to a deeper, high-contrast brown (such as #664d03 or #533f03) while keeping the light yellow background to preserve the warning aesthetic while meeting accessibility guidelines.
